name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This keeps the ring visible against any background while preventing it from obscuring adjacent content. The trade-off is slightly larger focus indicators than some design systems, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs the minimal extra space.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Use a 3px ring with 3px offset instead—it meets contrast and stays visible without bulk. Test with Playwright MCP to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px focus ring with a 3px offset on every interactive element. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on both light and dark backgrounds while keeping the ring clearly visible. The trade-off is a slightly tighter ring that may feel less prominent, but it avoids contrast failures and maintains usability for everyone.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 3px offset fails 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds when the ring color is #000000 at 80% opacity. Use #000000 at 90% opacity instead—it meets contrast and keeps the ring visible. Test with Playwright MCP to confirm.
